modified_caption: The line plot depicts the Word Error Rate (WER) during fine-tuning of the Whisper 'tiny' model using various weight quantization and adaptation methods across six epochs. The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6, while the y-axis shows the WER, spanning from 30 to 70. The 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' method, illustrated by a solid gray line with circular markers, initiates at approximately 70 WER and declines steadily to around 35 by epoch 6. The 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' series, marked by solid squares, starts at roughly 60 WER and stabilizes at 38 by the final epoch. The 'tiny int4' method, shown as a dashed line with circular markers, begins near 70 WER and decreases to 45 by epoch 6, exhibiting a less consistent downward trajectory compared to AdaLoRA variants. The 'tiny int8' approach, represented by dashed squares, commences at 60 WER and collapses to 30 by epoch 6, outperforming all other quantized methods. The 'tiny full' method, indicated by a dotted line with triangular markers, maintains the lowest WER throughout, starting below 30 and gradually declining to approximately 24. Notably, the 'tiny int8' method consistently surpasses the 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' variant after epoch 3, highlighting the efficacy of pure quantization over adaptive low-rank approaches in later training stages.

modifications.claim: The 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' series stabilizes at 38 by the final epoch.
modifications.reality: The 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' series actually stabilizes below 32 by epoch 6, not 38. The value 38 is approximately 20% higher than the true value, violating the observed trend.

modifications.claim: The 'tiny int4' method decreases to 45 by epoch 6, exhibiting a less consistent downward trajectory compared to AdaLoRA variants.
modifications.reality: The 'tiny int4' method decreases to below 40 by epoch 6, not 45. The claim also mischaracterizes the trajectory as 'less consistent,' whereas it follows a relatively smooth decline similar to other methods.

modifications.claim: The 'tiny int8' approach collapses to 30 by epoch 6, outperforming all other quantized methods.
modifications.reality: The 'tiny int8' method ends at approximately 37 WER, not 30, and does not outperform 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8,' which achieves a lower WER. The term 'collapses' is also a loaded verb exaggerating the rate of decline.

modifications.claim: The 'tiny int8' method consistently surpasses the 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' variant after epoch 3.
modifications.reality: The 'tiny int8' method never surpasses 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8'; the latter maintains a lower WER throughout the fine-tuning process. This is a comparison swap.
